lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines; spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section with a slight increase in density on the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first anterior line and the final four posterior lines terminate mid-flank, failing to extend to the ventral boundary of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A grouping of approximately 8 high-contrast spots is visible on the lower haunch and upper hind limb area.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A diagonal alignment of four spots is observable on the upper portion of the hind limb.

other_distinctive_markers: White chevron marking on the muzzle, two white spots on the lateral cheek, and high-contrast white interior ear hair.
